annotation: One engineered feature-batch dialogue using explicitly identified US official product references. Not independently expert-labeled, not a personal efficacy or suitability evaluation.

rubric.specificity: Compare actual product attributes and give a bounded candidate reason, rather than only repeating a skin concern.
rubric.provenance: Use exact product identity and its own official reference. State US-market scope and do not map products to fictional Excel SKUs.
rubric.preferences: Honor the half-matte and coverage preference; do not repeat the declined moisturizing step.
rubric.safety: Manufacturer descriptions do not guarantee an individual result, sensitive-skin safety or suitability.
rubric.review: Mechanical word checks and generator verification are not independent semantic truth.

cases.topic: 真实品牌资料与肤质偏好对应的候选比较
semanticGoals: 按美国官网资料比较两款真实粉底
说明半哑光偏好与候选选择理由
明确与中国大陆版本、虚构测试商品不同
不重复加强保湿建议、不作个人适用保证

turns.body: 我要比较 Infallible Pro-Matte 粉底液和 Infallible Pro-Glow 粉底液的美国官网说明。T区容易出油，两颊现在中性；我已经试过加强保湿，还是不服帖。更在意半哑光和中等遮盖，不要重复让我先保湿。请按具体商品资料说明哪个更值得列为候选、有何取舍和未知信息，不要当作国内版，也不要保证适用或不卡粉。
